title: Accept for Value | Your Legal Leg Up
channel: Your Legal Leg Up | Everything you need to beat the Debt Collectors
summary: Article explaining why accept-for-value bill schemes fail and what House Joint Resolution 192 actually did.

assertions.quote: The problem is, the theory doesn’t work.
they’ve put out circulars referring to laws that make it illegal and calling the whole thing fraud
But it didn’t make anything free for anybody.
it was a “legal tender” law which made all debts payable with bank notes rather than gold

verdicts.note: HJR 192 voided gold clauses and made US coin and currency legal tender for all debts.
HJR 192 made gold-payment clauses against public policy and US currency legal tender for all debts; the Supreme Court read it as tying obligations to the number of dollars promised.
